description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveConfigurationService in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes multiple test methods that verify configuration retrieval and setting functionalities related to leave management, utilizing mocking for dependencies.

classes.name: LeaveConfigurationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveConfigurationService functionalities, including mock setups and assertions for configuration retrieval and updates related to leave management.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
methods.description: Tests retrieval of leave entitlement consumption strategy setting using mocked ConfigDao.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleImplementation
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the work schedule implementation setting from configuration.

methods.name: testIncludePendingLeaveInBalance
methods.description: Verifies behavior of includePendingLeaveInBalance method with different return values.

methods.name: testSetIsLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Tests setting of leave period defined value.

methods.name: testIsLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Tests retrieval of whether leave period is defined.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Tests retrieval of leave period status.

methods.name: testSetLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Tests setting of leave period status.
